text: I think the director deliberately didn't choose the drama genre coz the protagonist pavunuthaayi is a strong person with a sense of humour. She has this don't care attitude yet shrewd money management. She didn't get divorce from her good for nothing husband and she did her best with and without her sons. The one thing that kept her going was her inner core strength and having a bit a laugh in everything. The freedom to be like her stems from deep agony.. and we see it in preclimax. Many village women, including my granny had incredible strength. They gave us tough love and showed us be intelligent. I learnt the habit of savings and having my own money, to be independent from my grannies. And I see them in pavunuthaayi. I relate to them. Coming to the loud songs.. it's the way to show the native life... There r still people who believe mgr is alive.. some even belive that mgr's watch is still ticking in his grave.. that's the innocence of the yester generation... The same is shown in this movie with a loud bang. It shows how people will suffer without having proper education too. The dark humour in their pain, their stupidity and ignorance coz of illiteracy... The director has made a strong point. I dunno if it's relatable to all... But the people who has roots in villages, and who has seen their grandmas and great grandmas.. will surely do, just like I did!

text:
This was one of the most thoroughly enjoyable movies  in recent days, and it is one of its kind which has a lot of messages in it. The message the movie carries is extremely, extremely  needed for these days. The whole theater was enjoying the movie mainly because of how the movie travelled with humor. When she reveals the message of what she was trying to convey  with her gestures, it was not just for comedy, it was an awe striking and hard hitting message. Everyone can relate to that.  

Every week Poovunthayi goes out and enjoys herself, and that itself is a life lesson. Instead of showing the usual dramatic story that she is secretly saving money for something big, the film shows a more realistic side of life. Even though she is very money minded, she still spends a little to keep herself happy. How many  elders actually do that these days

The way Rebecca reacts after hearing that Radhika has recovered also carries a hidden message. It can be interpreted in different ways depending on how the viewer connects with it. As mentioned in the movie, she is ready to face the world even if nobody is there for her. She knows that Radhika will come back, but at the same time she understands that life has to move forward no matter what happens. We can take that message in the way we want and relate it to our own lives. 
A must watch movie in theaters .Really appreciate the whole team for bringing such a wonderful movie!

text:
10ஆம் வகுப்பில் ஜஸ்ட் பாஸாகி 11ஆம் வகுப்பு செல்லும் பிரவீன் (கென் கருணாஸ்), எப்படியாவது ஒரு காதலிக்க வேண்டும் என்கிற எண்ணத்துடன் பள்ளிக்கு செல்கிறார். பள்ளியில் காதலிக்க தொடங்கி, கல்லூரியில் காதலை தொடர்ந்து, அதே பெண்ணை திருமணம் செய்யவேண்டும் என்பதே அவருடைய லட்சியமாக இருக்கிறது. 

ஆனால், ஒரு பெண் கூட இவருடைய காதலை ஏற்றுக்கொள்ளவில்லை. அந்த சமயத்தில் என்ட்ரி கொடுக்கிறார் மீனாட்சி. இவருக்கும் கென்னுக்கும் இடையே காதல் மலர, இந்த காதலை பிரிக்க வேண்டும் என்கிற சதியும் சிலரால் நடந்து வருகிறது........

மீனாட்சி தனது பாட்டிக்கு உடல்நிலை சரியில்லை என்கிற காரணத்தினால் ஊருக்கு செல்கிறார். இந்த சமயத்தில், சோனல் என்கிற பெண் கென்னிடம் தனது காதலை கூற, அவருக்கு நோ சொல்ல மறுக்கிறார் கென். இந்த நிலையில், கென் - சோனல் நெருக்கமாக இருப்பதை பார்க்கும் மீனாட்சி, கென்னுடன் பிரேக்கப் செய்கிறார்.

காதல் தோல்வியில் இருக்கும் கென்னுக்கு அனிஷ்மாவுடன் பழக்கம் ஏற்படுகிறது. இதுவரை நான் செய்தது காதல் இல்லை, இதுதான் உண்மையான காதல் என புரிந்துகொண்டு அனிஷ்மாவுடன் பழகி வரும் கென், தனது காதலை பள்ளியின் இறுதி நாளில் அவரிடம் கூறுகிறார். ஆனால், நான் உன்னை நல்ல நண்பனாகதான் பார்த்தேன் என அனிஷ்மா கூற, உடைந்துபோகிறார் கென்.

தொடர்ந்து காதலை தேடி கொண்டிருக்கும் கென்னுக்கு காதல் கிடைத்ததா? படிக்காமல் சுற்றிக்கொண்டிருந்த கென்னின் பள்ளி வாழ்க்கை என்னவானது? இதன்பின் அவர் என்னவெல்லாம் பிரச்சனைகளை சந்தித்தார் என்பதே படத்தின் மீதி கதை........சுராஜ் மற்றும் தேவதர்ஷினி ஆகிய இருவரும் வழக்கம் போல் தங்களுக்கு கிடைக்கும் கதாபாத்திரத்தில் சிறப்பாக நடித்துள்ளனர். அதே போல் மீனாட்சி, அனிஷ்மா, நளினி, கென்னின் நண்பர்களாக நடித்தவர்கள் என அனைவரும் தங்களுக்கு கொடுத்த ரோலில் தங்களுடைய பங்கை பொருத்தமாக செய்துள்ளனர்.

 ஹீரோவாக அறிமுகமாகியுள்ள கென் கருணாஸ் துள்ளலான நடிப்பில் பக்காவான யங் கமர்ஷியல் ஹீரோவாக திரையில் தெரிகிறார். நடனம், நகைச்சுவை, எமோஷ்னல், ஆக்ஷன் என அனைத்திலும் பட்டையை கிளப்புகிறார்.

நடிப்பு ஒரு பக்கம் இருந்தாலும், இயக்குநராக களமிறங்கியுள்ள கென்னுக்கு (கென் & கேங்) முதலில் வாழ்த்துகள். படத்தின் தொடக்கம் முதல் இறுதி வரை நகைச்சுவைக்கு பஞ்சமே இல்லை. தன் கதாபாத்திரம் உட்பட அனைத்து கதாபாத்திரங்களையும் வடிவமைத்த விதம் சுவாரஸ்யமாக இருந்தாலும், வழக்கமான ஒரு திரைக்கதையை வைத்து இதையெல்லாம் செய்தது சற்று வருத்தத்தை தருகிறது.

ஆரம்பத்தில் இருந்து தனது இஷ்டத்திற்கு சுற்றி கொண்டிருக்கும் ஒருவன், திடீரென ஒரு காரணத்திற்காக திருந்திவிடுவது என்பது நம்பிக்கையை கொடுத்தாலும், இதையே இன்னும் எத்தனை நாட்களுக்கு தான் திரையில் பார்ப்பது என்கிற சலிப்பு ஏற்படுகிறது. அது மட்டும்தான் இப்படத்தின் மிகப்பெரிய மைனஸ் பாயிண்ட்.

இதைத்தவிர, படத்தில் மிடில் க்ளாஸ் மக்களை தொடும் வகையில் வைத்திருந்த எமோஷ்னல் காட்சிகள், படிப்பு எவ்வளவு முக்கியம் என சொன்ன காட்சி, காதல் என்றால் எதிர்பார்ப்பு இல்லாமல் வருவது எதிர்பார்ப்புடன் வருவது அல்ல என சொன்னது போன்ற பல காட்சிகள் சிறப்பாக இருந்தது.

அதே போல், படத்தில் எங்கு தொய்வு வந்தாலும், அங்கு தனது பின்னணி இசையாலும், பாடல்களாலும் என்டர்டைன் செய்கிறார் இசையமைப்பாளர் ஜி.வி. பிரகாஷ். மேலும், கலர்புல்லான ஒளிப்பதிவு மற்றும் பக்காவான எடிட்டிங் படத்தை தூக்கி பிடிக்கிறது.

#Youth Review : "Ken Karunaas shines in a cheeky, harmless coming-of-age entertainer

[ RATINGS :  7/10 ]

👉Ken Karunas Energetic Performance

👉Enjoyable Friend gang sequence
👉Suraj Venjramoodu & Devadarshni Emotional Performance 
👉GV Prakash Worthy BGM & Songs 
👉Anishma Cute Performance 
👉Relatable Coming of age moments 
👉Surprising Intervel Block
👉Engaging Second Half 
👉Satisfactory Climax Portion

NEGATIVES 
👉Familiar Storyline 
👉Cliche Love Triangle Sequences 
👉Too much cinematic liberties & Logical Mistakes 
👉Bit Streached First Half

Final Verdict 
Overall, Youth is a fun youthful entertainer that works with its energetic moments, relatable emotions, and engaging performances. Ken Karunas impresses with his confident screen presence, and the film delivers a decent mix of humor and sentiment despite a few predictable scenes. A satisfying watch for youngsters and fans of light-hearted dramas.

​FInally,
RJB has truly saved the best for Karuppu. It is a pakka commercial entertainer that hits all the right notes!

Second half was a disappointment.  

Overall Surya as Karuppan is great. And scenes where he appeared was great. First half was also interesting. Second half was a let down.

திரையரங்கில் பார்த்த சில திரைப்படங்கள் மட்டுமே நம் மனதில் நீங்கா இடம் பிடிக்கும். நிச்சயமாக இந்த 'கருப்பு' திரைப்படம் அதில் ஒன்று.
15 மற்றும் 11 வயதுடைய எனது இரண்டு மகள்களுடன், குடும்பத்தோடு சென்று பார்த்தேன். ஒரு வாரநாளின் (working day) மாலை நேரமாக இருந்தபோதிலும், திரையரங்கம் கிட்டத்தட்ட நிரம்பியிருந்தது.
அந்த மகிழ்ச்சியான அனுபவம் உண்மையிலேயே சிலிர்ப்பூட்டியது (goosebumps). படத்தில் வந்த மாஸ் காட்சிகள் எல்லாமே எங்களுக்கு ரொம்பவே பிடிச்சிருந்தது. சொல்லப்போனால், ஒவ்வொரு சிறந்த காட்சிக்கும் திரையரங்கமே அதிரும்படி கைதட்டல்களும் கொண்டாட்டங்களும் இருந்தன.
இந்த காலகட்டத்திற்கு மிகவும் தேவையான ஒரு படம். 'காந்தாரா' திரைப்படம் போல, இந்தத் திரைப்படம் நம்முடைய கிராமத்து தெய்வத்தை இந்த தலைமுறைக்கு கொண்டு சேர்த்திருக்கிறது என்று நாம் பெருமையுடன் சொல்லலாம். இது ஒரு கமர்ஷியல் படமாக இருந்தாலும், ஒட்டுமொத்த அனுபவமும் மிக அற்புதம்.
அதிகம் யோசிக்காதீங்க மக்களே, தியேட்டருக்கு போய் பாருங்க. முழுமையான பொழுதுபோக்குக்கு (Fun) கேரண்டி!

text:
Karuppu 


ஒரு நல்ல கதையை வைத்து, ரசிகர்களை முழுக்க மூடன் மாதிரி நினைச்சு படம் எடுத்தால் எப்படிடி இருக்கும் என்பதற்கு உதாரணம் தான் இந்த படம். கதைக்கு நல்ல potential இருந்தது. ஆரம்பத்தில் curiosity இருந்தது. ஆனால் போகப் போக screenplay முழுக்க direction இல்லாம அலைஞ்ச மாதிரி feel வந்தது.
Hero mass scene காக logic, flow, emotional depth எல்லாத்தையும் sacrifice பண்ணிட்டாங்க. ஒரு scene முடிஞ்சதும் next scene naturally connect ஆகவே இல்ல. Audience என்ன feel பண்ணுவாங்க, கதைக்கு என்ன தேவை என்பதற்குப் பதிலா “hero elevation” மட்டும் focus பண்ணது ரொம்ப artificial ah தெரிஞ்சது.
Mass moments இருந்தாலும் அது organically வரலை. Forced ah push பண்ண மாதிரி இருந்தது. ஒரு நல்ல story இருந்தும் அதை engaging screenplay ஆ மாற்ற முடியாம waste பண்ணிட்டாங்க. Director கிட்ட clarity இல்லாதது பல இடங்களில் தெரியும்.
ஒரு ரசிகனா theatre la ukkanthu பாத்தப்போ excitement கும் மேல frustration தான் அதிகம் வந்தது. Concept நல்லது… execution ரொம்ப மோசம்.

26:00 The adage "excessive greed leads to ruin" (Adhi aasai, peru nashtam) has never been more relevant than in today’s film industry.
Decades ago, legendary production houses like AVM and Sivaji Productions operated on a foundation of financial independence; they produced films using their own capital, allowing them total creative and scheduling autonomy.
In contrast, today’s industry operates on a high-leverage model where over 90% of production houses lack internal funding. Instead, they rely heavily on external financing. This shift has created a precarious cycle:
author: @pradeep_pov
video_title: KJR Interview with Baradwaj Rangan | Angikaaram | Thenpathiyan | Ghibran | Viji Venkatesh | Swastik

text:
The Debt Trap: Because producers rely on high-interest loans from private financiers, they lose control over their release schedules.
The Financial Bottleneck: A film cannot secure a theatrical release until the producer settles the principal amount plus accrued interest with the financier.
The Chain Reaction: The producer’s ability to pay depends entirely on timely advances from distributors and theater owners. If there is even a minor delay in payments from any stakeholder, the financier withholds the No Objection Certificate (NOC), effectively stalling the movie’s release and incurring further interest costs.

text:
I felt the film had more funny jokes put in than an actual storyline. It made me facepalm over the scenes where the uncle told his niece that her dad is a 'wrestler' and not a househusband, as if he took shame over the very word. 

Acting wise: I felt the little girl's acting as the daughter stood out to me the most. Aishwarya and Vishnuu try their best to save a weak plot, and the supporting cast like the president's wife and the neighbors and villagers also try to make this work. The president does a great job at his jokes and well written dialogues.

Plot: We open to the scene of the father getting water for his house while literally pinching the women on the crowd, and the film ends with him kissing his wife on the neck to win a wrestling battle. 

I mean, how exactly does this man respect women again? He is an amazing househusband, props to him for that, but he fails in his one job, supporting his wife when she needed him and her daughter the most. 

No matter how uneducated his character is, if he has the brains to learn the recipes of beetroot juice and nutrious juices and make chutney and foods for his house, he at the same time is unable to google one medicine, and ends up ruining his wife's sports career for a year? He ends up becoming the catalyst to his wife's suffering and for what? To repeat the same plot of Gatta Kusthi 1? 

Parallels and repetition of predecessor film: in gatta kusti 1, the husband slapped the wife. Lo and behold, same repetition in gatta kusti 2. In the first film; there was a "long hair is attractive" idea, same darn thing here. In both films, the coach is the darn villain and trouble maker. The first film literally followed the same ending as the second, the wife and husband team up for a match, the wife falls unconscious, she is found to be pregnant. This really makes you wonder, what exactly did the writers get diffeently this time? 

Cons of the film: Voice dubbing is visibly incorrect and noticable, there are parts where the voices just come seconds after actors speak. Abrupt and weak ending, we did not even see the coach get his punishment, all that we got in terms of closure was the opponent keerthi had speak to her, and that too in the end credits of the film. There are so many unanswered questions, what happened to keerthi in that one year of her being debarred from sports, her bonding with her daughter, How does she forgive her husband for literally flirting with their daughters class teacher, and dancing with her when they were contemplating divorce? So many unanswered questions. 

Pros: The title, Gatta kusthi round 2, perhaps a creative choice. A happy ending, but at what cost? The film has its sweet spots, the music composed is among its only advantages; there are soulful tracks and some heartfelt lyrics. The fight sequences are satisfying and well executed, and the action is marvellous in the required parts. There is a scene where Vishnu explains the story of Aishwarya's struggles and basically the first film and how as a mother she made her own s!sacrifices, it was written and executed perfectly.
The jokes are extremely well written and woven into the plot, be it the president jumping in for comedic timing, or the whole Vijay dance nostalgia sequence, or even the whole courtroom drama for a predictable ending. Alls well that ends well I suppose.

text:
IDHAYAM MURALI is easily one of the coolest, most romantic, and stylish Tamil movies I've watched in recent times. It beautifully takes us on a nostalgic journey to the '90s while seamlessly blending it with the 2000s, making it a perfect treat for both 90s and 2K kids. A few scenes shot in Times Square add a grand, vibrant, and visually refreshing touch to the film.

There isn't a single dull or dragging moment. Not once did I feel like reaching for my phone. No unnecessary melodrama and just pure, realistic fun and wholesome entertainment from start to finish.

Note : This movie should be watched only with family / gang of friends/ or gf 🫶😀

The Characters ++++ Sudhakar, Adharva Murali, Niharika, Angelin, Rakshan, Dravid, Natty, Thaman, Jonita, and especially Fahadh Faasil. His climax entry scene was absolutely electrifying and completely worth the wait. I genuinely enjoyed watching a feel good, happy movie after a long time.

I personally feel Sudhakar from Parithabangal has the potential to become the next Yogi Babu or perhaps even surpass him. Both the heroines, Kayadu Lohar and Preity Mukundan, have tremendous screen presence and could well become the next Gen Simran/Trisha/Nayanthara/Tamannaah.

I know (Aakash Baskaran) is another 200 rs oopee talented slave who is heavily involved in many illegal and anti social activities. 

Dear Aakash kindly focus only on movies that can grow you just like this movie with note worthy cinematography and camera works.

IDHAYAM MURALI doesn't just entertain it keeps you engaged throughout with its twists, comedy, romance, and action, all placed exactly where they're needed.

The only thing I didn't like was the Red Giant reference, which felt unnecessary. Likewise, the dialogue during the Tamil cricket commentary by Tiger Garden Thangadurai came across as a political jab shows how low DMK can go to any extent and kneel down . 🔴⚫

While I wouldn't say the songs are exceptional, the background score beautifully elevates the romantic and emotional moments, leaving you with a warm, feel-good vibe.

text:
Mr. Baradwaj Rangan, you really lost my respect today.  
I’ve watched all your videos and always admired the way you explain cinema. But your take on Jananayagan feels completely off. The film simply wasn’t convincing.

Take the intro scene: in Bhagavanth Kesari, the moment with the grandpa and the water bucket had logical weight — NBK asking to wait until grandpa fills the water made sense. In Jananayagan, the remake collapses right there. Grandpa just wanting to sleep doesn’t carry the same emotional or logical impact.

Another example: in Bhagavanth Kesari, when NBK’s mother speaks against him, it had genuine emotional weight and carried the audience with her. That scene showed depth and conflict. But in Jananayagan, this kind of emotional layering was missing. Instead, Vijay was constantly shielded by “plot armour” — always having men around to guard him, protect him, or take the blame for him. To me, that felt like lazy writing.

Comedy in Bhagavanth Kesari worked beautifully, Kajal Aggarwal was awesome, and her chemistry with NBK in certain scenes was genuinely cute. But in Jananayagan, everything felt hurried and uneven — despite being 183 minutes long, the pacing was all over the place.

Yet you praised Jananayagan as if it were Interstellar. Really? Why such exaggeration? It makes me wonder if there’s some bias or profit behind this kind of praise.

From today, I won’t be watching your videos anymore. I respected your insights, but this review felt like blind glorification rather than honest criticism. I reject you as a professional film critic — you are just an ordinary reviewer like me.

text:
இந்தியாவில் நீட் தேர்வை அறிமுகப்படுத்த வேண்டும் என்று இந்தியாவின் 28 மாநிலங்களிலும் உள்ள சுமார் 26,000 அரசு மருத்துவமனைகளின் நிர்வாகமும், சுமார் 44,000 தனியார் மருத்துவமனைகளின் நிர்வாகமும், அப்போலோ மருத்துவமனை நிர்வாகம் உட்பட, இந்திய உச்சநீதிமன்றத்திடமும், மத்திய அரசாங்கத்திடமும் நீட் தேர்வு வேண்டும் என்று கோரிக்கை வைத்தன. மேலும், இந்தியாவில் 13.88 லட்சம் பதிவு செய்யப்பட்ட அலோபதி மருத்துவர்களும் மற்றும் 7.52 லட்சம் பதிவு செய்யப்பட்ட ஆயுஷ் மருத்துவர்களும் நீட் தேர்வை ரத்து செய்ய வேண்டும் என்று சொல்லவில்லை. மற்றும் 21 லட்சம் அனுபவம் வாய்ந்த டாக்டர்களும் நீட் தேர்வு வேண்டாம் என்று நடுத்தெருவில் உட்கார்ந்து போராட்டம் நடத்த வில்லை. டாக்டர்கள் அனைவரும் நீட் தேர்வை ஆதரிக்கிறார்கள். அதனால்தான், மத்திய அரசால் உடனடியாக எந்த நடவடிக்கையும் எடுக்க முடியவில்லை.

ஆனால், தற்போது பல மாணவர்கள் நீட் தேர்வுக்கு எதிராக போராட்டம் நடத்தி வருகின்றனர். எனது கருத்துப்படி, இந்தப் பிரச்சினைக்கு ஒரு நடைமுறைக்கு ஏற்ற நல்ல தீர்வு உள்ளது. மேல்நிலைப் பள்ளிகளில் அறிவியல் (Science) பிரிவைத் தேர்வு செய்து பிளஸ் ஒன் மற்றும் பிளஸ் டூ படிக்கும் மாணவர்களுக்கு, நீட் தேர்வுக்கான பாடத்திட்டத்தை பள்ளியிலேயே வழக்கமான பாடத்திட்டத்துடன் இணைத்து கற்பிக்க வேண்டும். இதனால், நீட் தேர்வுக்காக மாணவர்கள் தனியார் பயிற்சி மையங்களில் அதிக பணம் செலவழித்து படிக்க வேண்டிய அவசியம் இருக்காது. இது குறிப்பாக பொருளாதாரத்தில் பின்தங்கிய மாணவர்களுக்கு மிகவும் பயனுள்ளதாக இருக்கும். மேலும், அனைத்து மருத்துவக் கல்வி விரும்பும் மாணவர்களுக்கும் சமமான கற்றல் வாய்ப்பை உருவாக்கும்.

text: Jananayagan is the kind of movie that, according to me, should have focused mainly on the relationship between a father (or guardian) and his daughter, while exploring his past and present, along with his growing interest in politics and a meaningful social message. For me, that alone would've been enough. The first half has some beautiful Thalapathy moments that fans expect. I personally liked them, but I felt they repeated those moments so many times in the first half itself that, at one point, they didn't really make me feel as excited as they did the first time. My main problem with this movie starts in the second half. I personally felt the story keeps wandering into so many different topics in an attempt to keep the audience engaged. It touches on international issues, political issues, police issues, religious issues, modern warfare, and so many ongoing and past issues in Tamil Nadu. Because of that, I felt the movie never spent enough time letting its emotional core truly sink in. Even the "good touch, bad touch" scene, which had the potential to become one of the most serious scenes in the movie, just moves on like another message scene before it gets a chance to really make the audience feel its impact. Almost every scene starts with a simple, immediate goal, and once that goal is achieved, the purpose of that scene and its characters also feels finished. To me, that's exactly how most of the second half felt. For example, Viji's love and care for her Chiththa are literally shown through her words to her lover while Thalapathy secretly watches and cries. At that moment, I felt I should've been feeling Thalapathy's emotions too, but I just didn't. While Viji was talking about her Chiththa, I personally kept feeling, "Okay, I understand. That's enough. Let's move on." Instead of staying with its strongest emotional thread, the movie keeps picking up one issue after another. At one point, it feels like the writers took a spoonful of one issue, then another spoonful of a completely different issue, mixed them together with current political topics, and tried to make them all fit into the same storyline. To be frank, because of that, the movie keeps travelling everywhere but shines almost nowhere. One thing I genuinely loved throughout the film was Anirudh's background score. I personally feel that if his music wasn't there, quite a few scenes would've been much harder for me to sit through. Before watching this movie, I saw a meme saying, "Valimai is not officially H. Vinoth's worst movie anymore." After watching Jananayagan, I honestly understood why people were making that joke. I don't really care how much business this movie does at the box office. I just personally wish Thalapathy's final film had been something more grounded and emotionally personal, with a deep-rooted political message. I think that would've made a much more memorable farewell to his successful and illustrious cinematic career. I still didn't hate Jananayagan, but I definitely left the theatre wishing it had trusted its emotional core more than trying to cover so many different ideas at once. Personally, I think Thalapathy's final cinematic journey as Karuppu, entering Tamil Nadu politics to take revenge for his devotee, would've been a much more satisfying farewell as a fan. 😊

text:
Ulla olicha uyire ippa piriyathiru nee... Enga manasil eluthi vachom aliyaathiru nee.

Ithu cinema-va enaku intro panna aaloda knee-deep fan critique! Epdio oru vazhiya nama Thalapathy Vijay-oda kadisi padathuku review eluthitten.

Naan ivaroda padam paathudhan valarnthen boss. Pokkiri-la irundhu Jana Nayagan varai, en childhood, teenage, en cinema passion ellathulayum ivar thaan ellam. Adhanala dharisanam kidaicha indha show enaku verum movie matum illa... anbu Anna-ku oru emotional farewell!

Sema send-off... leaks-um spoilers-um illama social media-va avoid panni thappicha fans-ku periya salute! Ethana clips, ethana leaks fyp-la vanthukitte irundhuche. Naan april-leye padatha paathuten surprise miss aagakoodadhu nu. Aana official release-ku apram marubadiyum theatre-ku rendu thadava ponen! Thalapathy oda mass entry, fdfs loud roars, confetti, whistle satham, aaahaa... andha iconic screen aura-va theatre dark-la kadaisiya oru thadava experience pannanum nu thaan.

Sathiyama no regrets! Six months kitta wait panna worth-u thaan. Fireworks, crackers nu kitta thitta 100 euro selavu panni celebrate pannen. Atmosphere matum illa, entire audience-um thooki adichitaanga. Genuine fan show! Mass scenes-ku, hero intro-ku hall-e explode aaguradha paakkumpodhu thaan nammooru commercial cinema magic ennani puriyum.

Nallavelai Vijay Anna-vum nama Rockstar Anirudh-um irundhanga, illana Jana Nayagan nilamai romba paavam thaan. Thalapathy screen-la vanthaale puriyum ean ivaru Kollywood history-leye biggest goat-u nu. Charisma apdiye irukku. Pesaama ninnu look vittale screen full aaidum! Intro scene, andha forest fight, verithanamaana interval block, flashback, action set-pieces... ticket kaasuku aappu illama absolute mass moments-a thandhaachu! Forest sequence laam pure cinematic high!

Anirudh bhai pathi solla-va venum? Thalapathy-oda screen presence-a BGM-la pichi udharitaapla. Rendu perum sarntha indha combo modern Indian cinema-la eppovumiyum top-tier thaan.

Vijay Anna & Mamitha Baiju bond enaku semaya pudichirundhuchu. Padathoda emotional core-e ivanga thaan. Azaipara chaos naduvula ivanga scenes thaan paaka romba wholesome-a irundhuchu.

Aprom andha Title Card…

"THE HONOURABLE CHIEF MINISTER OF TAMIL NADU – THALAPATHY JOSEPH VIJAY."

Gooosebumps moment ! Fan-a paatha idhu verum text illa, oru era-voda climax-u!

Actually, padam election-ku munnadi varama late-a vandhadhu oru vagaila nalladhu thaan. Politically romba loud-a irukkuradhala core message adivaangirukum. Ippo Vijay Chief Minister aaitaru, avaroda government first steps paakurapo padathula irukra sila scenes-a vera perspective-la paaka mudiyudhu. Aana padathukulla TVK party references, tattoo, dialogue-u, flag resemblance designs laam konjam over-dose. Feature film paakura madhiri illa, campaign ad paakura feel vanthurudhu.

Aana enaku periya problem-e indha AI-usage thaan. Ivlo periya pan-Indian scale project-la visuals laam romba mokkaya irundhuchu. Africa sequence-la vantha AI graphics laam konjam kuda natural-a illa. Enaku irukkuradhulaye romba uncomfortable-a irundhadhu andha Black characters design & dialogues thaan. Stereotypical & offensive-a irundhuchu. Enoda Black friend-a kootitu poirundha nalla irundhirukaadhu. Idhu nalla illa, miss aaiduchu.

Screenplay-layum periya lag. Action blockbuster, international thriller, family sentiment, political crusade, corruption, democracy, women safety, AI, civil war nu ella topic-ayum thottu aana edhayumee proper-a convey pannala. Moonu vera vera padatha serthu cut-and-paste panna maadhiri irundhuchu.

And Lord Bobby Deol... Enna ya panni vachirukinga? Intimidating look irundhum, character writing ivlo mosama. Avaru avaroda alter-ego kooda fight panra scene laam unintentionally comedy aaiduchu. Budget Fight Club maadhiri irundhuchu, writing-la finesse-e illa. Sekram mudicha nalla irukkum nu thoniduchu. Friendly cop-a irundhu dictator-a aaguradha kan imaikura gap-la kattitaanga, emotion-e connect aagala.

Climax-la drone-u, laser-u, humanoid-u, choppy VFX, continuous action nu poite irukke thavira, emotion poyiduchu. Video game paakura maadhiri aaiduchu.

Aana ethana flaw irundhalum, Jana Nayagan-a enala hate panna mudiyadhu. Karanam idhu verum movie illa... text:
Like always, I usually wait to watch your review after I've seen the movie. But this time, I'm genuinely surprised. This has to be Vijay's weakest film, and it saddens me that a review I usually trust for being unbiased barely acknowledges its glaring flaws.

The screenplay is a mess, the political hero worship is so over-the-top it's almost parody, the character writing and arcs are painfully undercooked, the scene transitions are jarring, and the dialogues... I'd rather not even start.

I'm a Vijay fan, but after watching this, I fully support the previous government's decision to not let it release. Maybe they were trying to spare us the suffering.

For me, Leo or even GOAT is where Vijay's filmography ends. Jana Nayagan is one movie I'd happily pretend never happened.

Definitely some scenes where the school girl is being exploited, entire African story and awful CGI could have been avoided. The length of the movie vs the movie content did not go hand in hand. Not expecting all the directors to be like Rajamouli but at least there should be some base standard.

text:
Dear Madhavan:
I watched Anbe Sivam on Amazon Prime at 52 in 2026. What a movie! What a making! Acting is not how long you appear on screen, it's all about how key your appearance moves the plot. Your act in Durandhar is an example, watching it in North America with Pakistan audience, a fire. Kannaththil Muththamittaal, one of your best films. I loved all the tracks you acted in Dum Dum Dum. Run where I was in love too. When I think of my girlfriend, Run reminds me of them or vice versa. The Kaadhal Pisase was my go to song if I think of my days in ECR Chennai. Rang De Basanti, I watched it in Durban, what a role as a pilot! Nobody would have pulled off your cop's in VV, so real and set a benchmark for a thinking cop. Your role moves the plot every time Vedha is caught. Your worst movie Nala Damayanthi, JJ. I didn't watch Nambi yet.I will certainly watch GT, who was one of my idols in the 80s at KV. Like Aamir Khan reminds me of Tom Hanks, you do Brad Pitt.

Last but least, your Decoupled 🔥🔥 where you were reluctant to handshake with a teen boy 😊😊

Alaipaayuthe, Miinnale, 3 Idiots will certainly walk me down to my 20s where flings, affairs, love, romance, and what not were forming my formative years of those life-before-marriage days in Chennai ..

Overall, you're one of those few actors whose movie collections can be displayed on a cupboard or gifted to friends...😊

What about Abdul Kalam, Raajiv Gandhi, Sam Pitroda, TN Seshan, PV Naramimha Rao, Rakesh Sharma, Basu, Vallabhai Patel, Osho, Shashi Tharoor?

My pick:

Verghese Kurien
E. Sreedharan

M. S. Swaminathan
Sam Manekshaw
Ratan Tata

Thus Madhavan will be an actor of biographies 😊😊😊

💥 முதலமைச்சர் விஜய் அவர்கள் என்ன சொன்னாரு தெரியுமா அதாவது தமிழ் நாட்டில் உள்ள 234 தொகுதிகளும்‌ எனது என்று சொன்னார். மற்றும் முதலமைச்சர் விஜய் அவர்கள் தமிழ் நாட்டில் உள்ள அனைத்து துறைகளிலும் என்ன நடக்கிறது என்று கட்டாயம் தெரிந்துகொள்ள கடமையும் பொறுப்பும் உள்ளது. ஆகையால், முதலமைச்சர் அவர்கள் உடனடியாக 
தமிழ் நாட்டில் உள்ள சுமார் 1,854 காவல் நிலையங்களிலும் மற்றும் பின்வரும் காவல்துறை பிரிவுகளுக்கும் நேரடியாக சென்று ஆய்வு நடத்த வேண்டும் இந்த காவல்துறை பணியாளர்கள் எப்படி பொது மக்களுக்கு வேலை செய்கிறார்கள் என்று ஒருமுறையாவது பார்க்க வேண்டும்.

- காவல்துறை தலைமை இயக்குநர் (DGP) தலைமையகம்
- காவல் ஆணையரகங்கள் (Commissionerates)
- மாவட்ட காவல்துறை அலுவலகங்கள்
- ஆயுதப்படை காப்பு பிரிவு (Armed Reserve)
- தமிழ்நாடு சிறப்புக் காவல்படை (Tamil Nadu Special Police Battalions)
- போக்குவரத்து காவல்துறை (Traffic Police)
- குற்றப்பிரிவு – குற்றப் புலனாய்வுத் துறை (Crime Branch–CID)
- ரயில்வே காவல்துறை (Railway Police)
- கடலோர பாதுகாப்புப் பிரிவு (Coastal Security Group)
- சிறப்பு புலனாய்வு பிரிவுகள் (Special Investigation Units)
- காவல்துறை பயிற்சி அகாடமிகள் மற்றும் பிற சிறப்புப் பிரிவுகள்

*காவல்துறையின் பதவி வரிசை:*

1. காவலர் (Police Constable)
2. தலைமைக் காவலர் (Head Constable)
3. உதவி ஆய்வாளர் (Sub-Inspector – SI)
4. காவல் ஆய்வாளர் (Inspector)
5. துணைக் காவல் கண்காணிப்பாளர் (Deputy Superintendent of Police – DSP)
6. காவல் கண்காணிப்பாளர் (Superintendent of Police – SP)
7. துணை காவல் தலைமை ஆய்வாளர் (Deputy Inspector General – DIG)
8. காவல் தலைமை ஆய்வாளர் (Inspector General – IG)
9. கூடுதல் காவல்துறை தலைமை இயக்குநர் (Additional Director General of Police – ADGP)
10. காவல்துறை தலைமை இயக்குநர் (Director General of Police – DGP).

முதலமைச்சர் விஜய் அவர்கள், காவல் நிலையங்களிலும் மற்றும் நீதிமன்றத்திலும் இவர்கள் எல்லோரும் மக்களுக்கு எப்படி மரியாதை கொடுத்து மக்களுக்கு பொறுப்புடன் வேலை செய்கிறார்கள் என்று ஆய்வுகள் செய்ய வேண்டும். அதாவது, கருப்பு திரைப்படத்தில் வரும் தவறுகள் செய்யும் காவல் நிலையங்கள் மற்றும் நீதிமன்றங்கள் மாதிரி இருகிறதா என்று சரிபார்க்க வேண்டும்.

அப்போது தான், எதிர்காலத்தில் காவல் நிலையங்களும் மற்றும் நீதிமன்றங்களும் இன்னும் சிறப்பாக மக்களுக்காக சரியாக இயங்கும்.

சிந்தித்து செயல்படுவது நல்லது.!

அன்பான மக்களே விழித்துக் கொள்ளுங்கள்.!

நன்றி!

text:
Why Has Tamil Cinema Declined Over the Last 25 Years?

Tamil cinema since the 2000s has lacked genuine filmmakers and creators because almost every filmmaker seems to have come to Kodambakkam eventually wanting to act rather than simply direct. If they were truly passionate creators, they would remain focused on filmmaking instead of constantly venturing into acting.

Many of these directors-turned-actors are neither powerful creators nor professionally trained actors. As a result, Tamil cinema is gradually losing depth and quality in both departments: filmmaking and acting.

You rarely see this trend to the same extent in other major film industries in India, although there are some examples in Malayalam cinema as well.

text:
Devdas and Bonnie & Clyde-ah base panni ethana adaptions vandhalum... DC is FUCKING POWERFUL. Pure Tamil-style Natural Born Killers mixed with a heavy Devdas narrative. Indha combination-u "NO" sollave mudiyathu 🔥

Enna poruthavaraiku, Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay-oda Devdas novel-ku vandha single best adaptation and reimagining-ne indha DC-ah sollalam. Arun Matheswaran oru traditional romantic drama-wa remake panna try-e pannala. Devdas-oda core essence-aana self-destruction, olunga love panna mudiyadha pain, and inner suffering-a appadiye criminal rage-ah transform pannirukaru.

Antha twist thaan enna completely hook panniduchu. Namakku Devdas theriyum, athonoda tragic romance, alcoholism, Paro, Chandramukhi downfall ellam theriyum... aana Arun Matheswaran indha raw material-a eduthu gangsters, corruption, violence, and broken characters niranja oru dark universe-kulla thallitaaru. Copy adikkama, novel-a deconstruct panni oru entirely new dimension kuduthurukaru.

What a flex man! Particularly Mukesh G-yoda cinematography and film-oda technical staging paathu arandu poitend. Frame-la ethuvume casually vaikkala. Every background detail, camera movement, prop placement-nu elathukume oru deep narrative purpose irukku.

Enakku romba mind-la nikkura oru scene Oru corrupt cop oru innocent man-a rob panna povaan, apo camera police vehicle-kulla irundhu windshield-a paakum. Windshield-la "Kaaval" (Protection/Security) appadindra word reverse-a theriyum. Intha world-la Kaaval giradhu Inverted... yar kaappathanumo avangale threat-ah maritaanga appadindra huge thematic idea-va oru simple framing and set detail moolama convey pannirupparu. Absolute stroke of genius!

Innoru unhinged action sequence brothel-la nadakkum, anga wall-la Devdas Indian adaptations (including Sanjay Leela Bhansali & SRK version) posters-oda sethu Arthur Penn-oda Bonnie and Clyde poster-um ottirukkum. Anga thaan Arun enna panna varaan-nu puriyum. Plain set dressing illa, film explicit-a thalaila adichi solludhu indha rendu major influences-a patthi. Masterclass meta touch!

At the same time, oru simple visual-aale emotional impact create panna mudiyum-nu innoru scene-la kaattirupparu Devadas and Chandra beach-la pesura scene. Suthama impressive sets, crowd, props ethuvume irukathu... Just two of them.

And that’s why it works! That frame completely isolates them from the world. Gangsters, violence, police, trauma ellam visual-a vanish aaidum. Dedicated safe space for Devadas & Chandra to just exist.

Indha level of directing thaan Arun Matheswaran-a true visionary-ah kaattudhu. Already Saani Kaayidham, Captain Miller, and ipo DC paathachu (only Rocky pending in watchlist, strictly updating ASAP). Matheswaran’s filmography process panna panna, avaroda directorial signature evlo distinct-ah irukku-nu puriyudhu. Cruel, highly violent, uncomfortable... yet dripping with symbolism and layered messaging.

Saani Kaayidham, Captain Miller, or DC-la irundhu oru single frame without context kaattinaalum, "Yep, ithu Arun Matheswaran film thaan"-nu instant-ah solla mudiyum. Framing, violence composition, spatial usage, background detailings... he literally built his own visual language.

Gore and graphic violence neraya irundhalum, ethuvume cheap shock value-kaaga vekkala. Character-oda mental state-a represent panna violence-a oru emotional language-a maathiruppaaru. Cut and editing speed-aala action set-pieces-la rage explosion feel aagum.

And Anirudh... bro gives the film a legit heartbeat! Score vandhu visual-oda serndhu travel aagudhu. Just background music-ah illama, thematic cues moolama scenes-a vere level peak-ku thookittaru.

Acting side-la Lokesh Kanagaraj in front of the camera completely caught me off guard! Raw intensity, physical presence, inner rage-nu character-ukku super-ah fit aagitaaru.

Wamiqa Gabbi as Chandra was PHENOMENAL. Violent men niranja world-la avaloda own narrative-a ava reclaim panra arc-a beautifully written. Pure survival drive & violent body language-la heavy Kill Bill energy tharuvanga.

Supporting characters-um thooki saaptanga. Krish Dayal as that sadistic, sarcastic cop... absolute surprise packet! Screen-kulla kaiyyooruthu adikkalaam pola irundhuchi 😭 Avinash Raghudevan-um indha dense story-la energetic presence kuduthurupparu. Writing-la yaarayumey waste pannala, backstories and emotional weight accurate-ah carry aagudhu.

Underneath all the blood & rage, family, choices, emotional consequences, and trauma cycle-a pathi pesa koodiya tragic core irukku. That's why DC isn't just another ultra-violent gangster flick. Devdas-oda bottle and romantic decay-a crime and raw rage-ah translate panniyirukanga.

Big screen-la indha bold reinterpretation-a experience pannadhu semma treat. Every sequence has a solid identity. DC is an iconic blend of Devdas, Bonnie & Clyde, crime cinema, and revenge subgenre. Arun Matheswaran is a filmmaker with true vision and identity.

And lastly... padam varadhukku munnadi Lokesh Kanagaraj-a troll panni, bully panna gang-ku Go fuck yourselves now! 😂 Loki answered with pure cinema 🔥

First-u, indha Indian cinema-la Generative AI-ya normalize panradhu irukke... Sathyama romba depressing-a irukku. "Art-la profit-driven AI venaam" nu evlo dhaan kathinaalum, namma filmmakers-ku puriyave maatteengudhu. At the end of the day, avangaloda own industry evolution-aye thalaila mann pottu kedukkuranga.

And unfortunately, padathoda thodakkathulaye enna nalla mood-la irundhu veliya izhutha vishayamum idhu dhaan. Honestly, G.D.N. paper-la paatha periya jackpot project oru amazing historical figure, kandippa solla vendiya story, solid budget, and above all, lead-la Maddy! Actually, padathoda best part-e Madhavan dhaan.

Sathyama insane performance. G.D. Naidu-oda different life stages-a Maddy embody panna vidham voice, posture, physical presence, body language-nu pramidhu poga vaakkuraaru. Costume matum pottutu vandhu nikkama, literally usura kuduthu G.D. Naidu-vaave maariyirukkaaru.

Idhukku Ranjith Ambady-oda makeup work-um nallave help pannirukku. Age transitions ellam mostly seamless-a irundhadhaala, Maddy-ala dynamic-a move aaga mudinjudhu. Aana oru chinna doubt... Maddy recent times-a yen ippadi oru biopic streak-la irukkaaru? Plus enna oru strange obsession with balding characters? 😭Dhurandhar, ippo G.D.N.... bro, konjam unga hairline-ku break kudungalen! 😂

Jokes apart, Maddy-oda commitment-a naan sathyama admire panren. Padaththeyae thol-la thangi nirkka vaakkuraaru, aana sad part ennanu paatha, script avarukku podhiya emotional depth kudukkala. G.D. Naidu-va patti tons of information tharaanga, aana avar manasukulla enna podhunnu nammala feel panna vaakkala. Inventions, successes, conflicts, mistakes, life stages-nu ellam oru bullet point list madhiri vanthutte irukku. Idhanaala padama irukka vendiyadhu oru checklist-a maariduchu: An invention -> A problem -> A solution -> A new conflict -> A new invention -> repeat. Full-a chronological order-la poga tri panradhula, real dramatic tension-e miss aagiduchu.

Adhanaala, mid-section romba sluggish-a, mechanical-a, downright exhausting-a maariudhu. Enakku Rocketry: The Nambi Effect paakkumbodhume idhe flaw dhaan thonuchu. Ivlo periya historical events fast-forward-la ponadhaala, edhuvume emotional-a heart-la land aagala.

Aana oru vishayam appreciate panni aaganum script avarai oru flawless hero-va sanitize panna try pannala. Avaroda flaws, hubris, personal choices, marriage, and even Nazi Germany mela irundha admiration-a kooda open-a kaattiyirukkaanga. Indha contradictions-a preserve pannadhaala, idhu oru generic hagiographical biopic-a maaraama thappichudhu. Industry, transport, technical education-nu avar panna revolution-a ippo irukku generation discover panna idhu oru nalla chance. School textbooks-la avarai add panradha patti varra debate-um nalla educational layer.

Padam elumbi nikkum podhu, vera level-la irukku! Opening act super effective G.D. Naidu-oda background, early ambitions-a semma momentum-oda set panraanga. First major set-piece-la irundha energy-a paathuppo, "baah, enna oru potential!" nu thonuchu.

Sathyaraj sir scene-ku periya weight kondu varraaru, and Jayaram as an antagonist top-class! Avarunga rendu perukku naduvla varra showdown is a top-tier interval block. Dushara Vijayan-um thannodha strong screen presence-alaye pala scenes-a ground panraanga. And then came the final 30 minutes... ABSOLUTE PEAK CINEMA! Pacing ramp up aagi, tension spike aagi, emotional beats gubeer-nu hit aagi, oru vazhiya padam thaan paarkka asaippatta dramatic power-a adanjuduchu. Aana idhu dhaan enaku romba frustrating-a irundhudhu... enna ippadi kadasila mattum kaatturadhukku badhila, muzhu padatheyum masterpieces-a aakkiyirukkalaame!

The character was there, lead actor was there, scale was there, historical beats, performances... ellame irundhudhu. Aana idhellathaiyum onna inaikka oru unified vision miss aagiduchu. And, hostly, antha Teejay to Madhavan transition casting choice enna bro? 😭 Age kaattanum okay, aana Teejay-va irundhadhu epdi Maddy-a maaruvaaru? Physical resemblance-e illama adhu sathyama illusion-a break pannudhu. Maddy-va vachae digital de-aging, makeup, or prosthetics panni gradual transformation kaattiyirukkalaam. Performance continuity-e poiduchu, Maddy build panna rhythm-e fracture aayiduchu.

Padathula clear artistic intent and visual cohesion miss aagudhu. Oversaturated sepia color grade paakave artificial-a irukku. Grounded look kuduthirundha set design-um actors-um innum breath panniyiruppanga. Plus, again, indha generative AI issue...

Major commercial projects-la ippadi shortcuts edukkuradhu romba sad-a irukku. Set design, costume, visual effects, concept art-nu 100-kanakkanor usura kuduthu work panra oru medium-la, all that human artistry-a aatti thallittu AI-ya kooti varradhu yen? Indian cinema-la talent-ukkaa panjam? Legendary technicians, master cinematographers, world-class makeup artists irukko-kaalathula indha gimmick thevaiyae illai.

Overall-a, G.D.N. landmark biopic-a irunthirukka vendiyadhu, Maddy-oda phenomenal performance-alaye thangi nikkura oru decent film-a mudinjuduchu. Mixed feelings dhaan. Maddy-kaga and G.D. Naidu sir story-kaaga idhai paarthadhula enaku regret illa, but I just wish the film had dared to be bolder.

Aana performance, interval block, especially antha final 30 minutes... idhellam paatha kulla oru masterpiece olunjirundhurukku nu puriyudhu. Now, Netflix-la varra LEGACY mela periya expectations irukku! Teaser-a paatha Maddy-ku oru massive Tamil comeback madhiri dhaan theriyudhu. Continuous biopics-ku appram, avarai oru sleek, contemporary role-la paarkka aasaia irukku!

God save us from these PSEUDO-TOXIC MOVIES & HEROES who seem to have forgotten that glorifying violence doesn't make them heroes.

Give us STORIES, NOT SLAUGHTER.

Give us HEROES, NOT VIOLENCE MACHINES.

Sudhir sir, I enjoyed the album as well, very much, and I too believe it's his 2nd best album of the past decade. But I can't help but question the AI used in the songs. Bum Baa Diga Diga, Don't Give A Damn, Echoes of DC, vocals in Hangova all have AI usage in them. I can't imagine ANIRUDH of all people using AI in such a brilliant album, and I can't help but notice all the other non-AI songs sound so much more beautiful in comparison to the AI songs.
I personally dislike the use of AI in a creative field such as music, especially as I have experience in this field. The fact Anirudh is using AI now so freely in almost 3 songs of the album is quite strange to me. What do you think?
Still a brilliant album.
